scenes.headline: Why your stop keeps getting hit.
scenes.say: Why your stop keeps getting hit, right before price goes your way.

scenes.headline: A stop inside normal noise.
scenes.say: This stop sits half an ATR below entry. ATR is the average true range, how far price normally moves in one bar. An ordinary dip takes it out.

scenes.headline: Stop at 1.5 ATR, smaller size.
scenes.say: At one and a half ATR, the same dip is just noise. Make the stop wider and the position smaller, so the dollar risk stays the same.

scenes.text: Follow for one trading concept a day.
